title: Certificate Verification
subtitle: Verify the authenticity of an NYTI certificate.

features.title: Scan the QR code
features.body: Every certificate carries a QR code that opens this page with the ID pre-filled.

features.title: Official record
features.body: Results come directly from the NYTI certification registry, including partner-issued certificates.

features.title: Privacy first
features.body: Only the holder's name, course, issuer and dates are shown. No contact details.
